description: A rustic wooden dining table with a rich brown finish and a distinctive teal-colored base. The tabletop is composed of several planks, showcasing a natural wood grain and subtle imperfections that add to its charm. The base features elegant, turned legs and decorative carved elements, giving it a slightly vintage or farmhouse aesthetic. This table appears to be extendable, with visible seams between the tabletop planks suggesting it can be widened to accommodate more people. Its design balances a sturdy, functional form with decorative details.
